tagline: 奥林巴斯数码单反相机，2008 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于2008年推出的数码单反相机。配备Four Thirds。快门速度focal-plane shutter。

specs.传感器: Live MOS Four Thirds 17.3 mm x 13.0 mm(2× conversion factor)
specs.取景器: Eye-Level TTL Optical Pentaprism with 98% coverage and 1.02X magnification
specs.闪光灯: E-TTL II automatic built-in pop-up, 13 m ISO 100 guide number, 27 mm (equivalent in 135 format) lens focal length coverage; compatible with Canon EX Series Speedlite external hotshoe-mount flashes
specs.屏幕: Vari-Angle 2.7" HyperCrystal III TFT LCD with 230,000 pixels
specs.存储: CompactFlash Type I/II (UDMA), Microdrive, xD-Picture Card
